summary:
Modernized API/payment logging: invoice creation now uses structured `logger.info`, payment failures use `logger.exception` with invoice IDs, and log formatting includes request IDs via `RequestContextMiddleware`. Added coverage for active and inactive request contexts, updated health-log expectations, and verified configuration output and credential-field searches. Targeted tests pass; full suite reached 142 passed, 3 skipped, with the sole failure fixed afterward.

The new priority is the nightly reconciliation refund double-counting bug in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`; investigation has not yet begun. A scheduler DST recurrence failure also remains: `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py` combines stored dates with naive times and creates timezone-aware datetimes without DST normalization. The March transition test expects 09:00 but receives 10:00; recurrence and timezone serialization code were identified for review.

Do not perform the Tenacity refactor this sprint. Use the sbx-pay-c sandbox. Keep commits small, multi-ticket changes on separate branches, and report exact test results.
